reuse.why: Collapses the repeated category queries into getMonthActionCategories, but restates the 'saved UI template' test as inline SQL (the COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(template_settings...)) fragment from statements.ts) and does not reuse the new selection in copyPreviousMonth.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the avg-action query, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own separate hidden check in JS and the template-source expression is copied from statements.ts/cleanup-template-notes.ts.

placement.why: The shared selection lives in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use it, which fits the tree's layering.

scope.why: Only the month-wide action selection and a test for it.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rule is now split between an SQL WHERE clause for four actions and a JS hidden check in copyPreviousMonth that lacks the template rule, so the two paths will drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts still filters with its own `prevBudget.hidden === 1 || prevBudget.group_hidden === 1` instead of the new getMonthActionCategories rule.

disguised_duplication.where: The template-source test in getMonthActionCategories is a recognisable copy of the COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(...,'$.source'),'notes') fragment in statements.ts, only negated.

one_place.where: The rule lives in getMonthActionCategories (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) but copyPreviousMonth applies its own hidden-only check via getBudgetData and never applies the saved-template exclusion.
